name: button
title: Button
description: An accessible action component with semantic variants and link support.

references.name: shadcn/ui Button
localChanges: Uses Base UI Button instead of the upstream Radix Slot composition.
Preserves the upstream variant vocabulary while adding pending state, content slots, and link semantics.
Moves component styling into the @iuvui/styles CSS package.
Keeps hover, press, and focus-visible on iuvui data attributes. Base UI Button only emits disabled state.
